overview: What happened to the pop princess? Perfect incarnation of the American dream and its excesses, Britney Spears appears to be the guinea pig of modern celebrity. In five episodes, this documentary series retraces the trajectory of the first pop star of the 21st century and reveals the workings of a spectacle society which is running on empty, fueled by the gaze of us all.
title: Britney sans filtre

overview: Louis Malle called his gorgeous and groundbreaking Phantom India the most personal film of his career. And this extraordinary journey to India, originally shown as a miniseries on European television, is infused with his sense of discovery, as well as occasional outrage, intrigue, and joy.
title: L'Inde fantôme

overview: Five pairs of strangers face 21 days isolated in the Colombian jungle, confronted with nature's greatest dangers - and completely naked.
title: Aventura en pelotas: España

overview: Síorstíl is a cutting-edge sustainable fashion competition where six talented designers transform second-hand clothes and recycled materials into high fashion editorial garments. Over the course of six episodes, our contestants face a series of challenges in a bid to become Síorstíl champion.
title: Síorstíl

overview: The volunteer is the heart and soul of the GAA. The prestigious President's Award is presented to 11 volunteers every year for their long-standing commitment and dedication in their respective field within the GAA.
title: Gradaim an Uachtaráin

overview: Live basketball coverage.
title: Cispheil Bheo

overview: A new documentary will tell the story of Éamon de Valera's wilderness years from 1924 to 1926, and of the strong women who supported him – but would ultimately be betrayed. The programme, titled De Valera san Fhásach, will show the political leader being imprisoned, in poor mental health and stripped of his political power. It will also depict the radical, revolutionary women activists who stood by him during this difficult time.
title: De Valera San Fhásach

overview: The characters of the sketchcom are intelligent, reflective, sweet and funny characters, through which ironic meanings are conveyed. The show in the spirit of old British sketches, but in a new manner, will make you smile and reflect on the subtleties of existence.
title: Лошадь Пржевальского

overview: A former elite lawyer turned private detective, he specializes in solving complex inheritance cases. Operating his own office, he uses his intelligence and the help of eccentric allies to uncover hidden truths and resolve family conflicts. A coffee enthusiast with a dislike for the phrase "Dead men tell no tales," he respects the deceased's will while seeking justice.
title: Inheritance Detective

overview: Fresh in the kitchen, Hudson needs to beef up his culinary foundations. Starting in his own back yard of Los Angeles, California - he must learn the skills needed to kickstart his culinary adventure.
title: Order Up With Hudson Yang

overview: Hélène Hendriks, assisted by regular sidekick Rutger Castricum, receives different guests every week and talks to them about current affairs.
title: De Oranjezondag

overview: One of the most diverse countries on Earth, Colombia's two stunning coasts provide a remarkable variety of life. See the magnificent creatures that live below the waves and on the beaches.
title: Colombia's Wild Coast

overview: Rosa Salvaje is a Mexican telenovela that was broadcast in 1987. It starred the popular Mexican actress Verónica Castro, who played the main character, "Rosa", co-starring with Guillermo Capetillo as her love interest and Laura Zapata as the villain of the story. This telenovela was a huge success in Mexico, Latin America, Bulgaria, Croatia, Serbia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Russia,Estonia, China the United States, Indonesia and provided the template for numerous other Latin American soap operas in terms of story, plot twists and characters for years to come.
title: Rosa Salvaje

overview: Chef Will Meyrick embarks on an exciting journey through Kolkata's vibrant street food scene.
title: Street Food Nomad: Kolkata

overview: Highlights from the Cycling: National Road Championships.
title: Cycling: National Road Championships

overview: Highlights from Women's football.
title: Women's Weekly Football

overview: Home cooks compete to impress four of the country's toughest and most feared food critics.
title: Eating with the Enemy

overview: Complete strangers with opposite perspectives on a variety of topics share a meal together under the observation of psychology and human behaviour experts.
title: Eating with the Enemy

overview: Mi pequeña Soledad is a Mexican telenovela. As a young girl, Isadora is voted to become the Silver Queen in Taxco, a Mexican village known for its silver handicrafts. The night before the coronation, in an act of jealousy, Isadora's former boyfriend Gerardo rapes her. For weeks Isadora refuses to tell anyone, but because of the strong love and trust she feels for her fiancé José Luis, she decides to tell him about it. Just before the wedding, Gerardo confronts José Luis and provokes a fight. José Luis never arrives at the church for his wedding, and is later found stabbed to death. Isadora is carrying Gerardo's child, and her stepmother Piedad is terrified that this will force Gerardo to marry her. Piedad is jealous of Isadora, and decides to get rid of the child at the first opportunity. Isadora leaves her family and moves to the city. Several years later, Soledad has grown into a kind and beautiful woman, and she moves to the city where she and Isadora meet.
title: Mi pequeña Soledad

overview: A girl who lives a difficult life but strives for self-improvement met and fell in love with the indifferent CEO Fu Xuan Yi. Fu Xuan Yi's favor freed Wei Yu Xian from the shackles of her family, and the two finally lived happily together.
title: Being Pampered During Pregnancy

overview: Surviving Black Hawk Down tells the gripping real story of the horror and heroism behind the events that inspired Ridley Scott's blockbuster movie Black Hawk Down, blending raw, immersive storytelling with first-person interviews from both sides of The Battle of Mogadishu.
title: Surviving Black Hawk Down

overview: It is 1926, the first year of the Showa era. Urabe Kanoko has left her hometown after it turns against her for having the ability to hear lies when spoken. She collapses from hunger after arriving in a town called Tsukumoya, where she meets a poverty-stricken detective named Iwai Souma. Is this fate? Or something more?
title: Usotoki Rhetoric

overview: The story of the eldest sister-in-law, who becomes the breadwinner after her husband's sudden death 10 days after marriage, and five brothers with a brewery that has been manufacturing traditional liquor for three generations.
title: For Eagle Brothers

overview: Woo Seul-Ki grew up in an orphanage out in a province. She moves to Seoul and enrolls in Chaehwa High School, which is a school for the top 1% students in South Korea. Woo Seul-Ki doesn't get along with the other students. A student named Yoo Je-Yi approaches her and they become friends. Yoo Je-Yi is the most powerful student in the school. She has a high IQ, comes from a wealthy family background, and is attractive physically. She has lived as the envy of other people since she was born and she is aware of her superiority. She is also cunning enough to know how to take advantage of her position. She shows special interest in transfer student Woo Seul-Ki. They soon develop a dangerous relationship between friendship and obsession.
title: Friendly Rivalry

overview: 7 detectives, each with their own unique style in problem solving work at the same detective agency. Each detective is in charge of their own case file until one day, the cases somehow seem to tangle up together into one big mystery. Inevitably, the detectives are without choice but to team up together in tackling the intriguing, but knotty mystery. Despite differing opinions and amidst complications, the detectives work together to unravel the truth behind the suspect's agenda.
title: Lucky Seven

overview: The white Bronco. The gloves. The trial of the century. This documentary series investigates the shocking murder case that became a cultural phenomenon.
title: American Manhunt: O.J. Simpson

overview: What happens when one of Sápmi's and Norway's biggest influencers and celebrities, Erlend Elias Bragstad, questions his entire family history? In the reality series Röda mattan or reindeer? he leaves his glamorous red-carpet life to find out if he really is the same - or if everything was just a family crown he and half the family have passed on.
title: Röda mattan eller renar?

overview: A teacher at a struggling school is devastated by the death of her star pupil at the hands of a criminal ex-boyfriend. She accidentally avenges the murder, and quickly finds herself.
title: Juffrou X

overview: A law firm in South Africa takes on various cases, while the partners and associates need to balance their personal lives and keep the firm alive.
title: Fynskrif

overview: The story of a man with a military background, Ivan Malan, and his partner, Paul Schmidt, who plan and carry out a theft from a gang boss. The prize is the Flame Girl - a painting by the master painter Vermeer that is worth EUR30 million.
title: Plan B
Wo die Liebe hinfällt – Jedes Paar ist anders

overview: "Let's date until we graduate." Woohyun has a secret crush on his homeroom teacher. His best friend, Doha, finds out and confesses his feelings for him. But then he makes an interesting proposition: "Go out with me. Fall for me before graduation, and I win. If you don't, you win." Can Woohyun like someone other than his teacher?
title: Heart Stain

overview: In the unique and inimitable setting of the city of Palermo, the Corsaro brothers move. Fabrizio is a black journalist, Roberto is a criminal lawyer: for this reason they often find themselves forced to work on the same case. Impulsive and libertine Fabrizio, precise and calm Roberto, despite the constant bickering, will be able to solve even the most difficult of mysteries.
title: I Fratelli Corsaro

overview: For a bold voice in journalism and a fresh perspective on the daily news cycle, watch Canada Tonight. Live
title: Canada Tonight
Mo Fang You Xi Zhi Zui Sha

overview: British reality television show where Paris Hilton searches for her new British best friend and is the second incarnation of the My New BFF franchise.
title: Paris Hilton's British Best Friend

overview: Killer Di Shiqi disguises herself as a princess sent for a political marriage to enter the palace to carry out an assassination. By fate, she meets the Fifth Prince, Ouyang Shao, and falls in love with him. However, her master holds her family hostage and forces her to kill the prince. Torn between the inescapable mission and undeniable love, they decide to fight against destiny only to stay with each other.
title: To Love or To Defy

overview: "Pregnant by Deception" is the first reality show about women who became victims of deception by married men. They hoped for a strong and long relationship, their lovers promised them a reliable family. And now, after getting pregnant by their beloved man, they find out the truth - their man is married and leads a double life.
title: Беременна по обману

overview: The Takedown: American Aryans takes viewers inside the cult-like world of the Aryan Brotherhood of Texas from the late 2000s to the present day. Told principally by charismatic federal agent Richard Boehning, the series examines an organized crime group built on Nazi ideology and extreme violence operating under the radar in the suburbs of Texas. The shocking murder of a young woman catapults Boehning and his Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives (ATF) task force on an odyssey to protect American values against an enemy growing in confidence and power.
title: The Takedown: American Aryans

overview: Inspired by Henry Hampton's legendary documentary series "Eyes on the Prize: America's Civil Rights Movement," this new installment of the groundbreaking 1987 series illuminates the bold stories of people and communities who continue to work for equity and racial justice in the years since the birth of the American civil rights movement. This new chapter of the iconic series begins in the late 1970s and continues into 2015, with episodes examining the strategies of those who fought for racial equality across multiple decades. As in the original production, diverse teams of acclaimed filmmakers bring each story to life by showcasing the work of citizens in an ever-more multicultural society working to achieve true equity.
title: Eyes on the Prize III: We Who Believe in Freedom Cannot Rest 1977-2015

overview: All new series coming up on the channel in February. De Wereld van Luiten takes you behind the scenes with the Luiten family as we follow up and coming Dutch Dressage superstar Marten Luiten on his way to the top. Real life, entertaining and informative.
title: De Wereld van Luiten

overview: In this new six-part UKTV Original series, award-winning mechanical engineer, Dr Shini Somara, will turn to back copies of Practical Mechanics magazine - once the best-selling bible of British inventors -and challenge a dream design team to reinvent its vintage blueprints for the 21st century. Each week, Dr Shini will lead a diverse crew of engineers, crafters and gadgeteers as they try to update these vintage designs from the 30s, 40s and 50s and make them fit for purpose in the modern world. Working from a vintage shed on a Yorkshire airfield, the build teams will be drawn from a pool of returning experts, with Dr Shini allocating team members to the projects that most suits their skills. The reinvention challenges range from a build-at-home car, a boat and a camping trailer…to a pedal-powered washing machine, a burglar alarm and a lie detector. They've set themselves just four weeks - the time between each edition of the magazine – in which to design and build them.Filled with imaginative and ambitious designs - and combining old-fashioned DIY skills with clever modern technology - the series aims to re-ignite the nation's passion for innovation.
title: Masters of Reinvention

overview: Advertising maven Monica Marks and her loyal right hand executive Doug Garcia have long been at the top of the Madison Avenue world. But after a record scratch blunder, they are suddenly canceled, pushed out and replaced by the agency's rising Gen Z employees led by social media manager, Kriska Thompson. Refusing to go quietly, Monica launches her biggest campaign yet – getting their careers back and taking down the eager team of Gen-Zers who are just getting comfortable in their new roles. May the best generation win.
title: The Z-Suite

overview: Adventurer Ben Fogle gets a taste of extreme escapism in this brand new series meeting those who have turned their backs on the daily grind. Each week, Ben spends time in one of the world's most remote locations, meeting the people who now inhabit these inhospitable corners of the planet after leaving their ordinary lives behind. Our intrepid guide also wonders whether these extraordinary individuals and their incredible experiences might tempt him to move his own family out of London and away from the comforts of the city. Is it daring or downright crazy? Ben wants to discover the truth about life in tough, harsh conditions, where doing battle with Mother Nature is a daily reality.
title: Ben Fogle: New Lives in the Wild

overview: Fronted by Buyers Agent Liz O'Kane, Help me Buy a Home unpacks the unfiltered realities Irish people face in the search for a home. Following real life experiences, this series takes a raw and honest look at the emotional rollercoaster, challenges, and hard-won joys of buying a home in Ireland.
title: Help me Buy a Home

overview: Eight country-by-country accounts of the origins of the Second World War written and narrated by Charles Wheeler.
title: The Road to War

overview: A series of murders are occurring in a small town. They have a mystical, ritualistic nature. The investigation reaches a dead end, and locals say a mermaid, the subject of many legends, is to blame. Yuri Bakhtin, a specialist in serial killers, is sent from Moscow to assist the investigation. He doesn't believe in mermaids, but the more he immerses himself in the case, the more he begins to doubt the veracity of his beliefs. In addition to the investigation, Bakhtin must also deal with family issues. It turns out he lived in this town many years ago, and not only has old friends there, but also his ex-wife. As the investigation progresses, the list of suspects only grows, including people close to Bakhtin. Navigating the law, family problems, and obstacles from the antagonist, Bakhtin tracks down the killer.
title: Зов русалки

overview: KGB officer Viktor Shvets is sent to occupied Taganrog, where he must organize and lead intelligence and the underground. Shvets gets a job in the occupation authorities under the guise of a Volga German, Gustav Schwartz. Thanks to his actions, the underground movement grows to hundreds of people: they commit sabotage, distribute leaflets, save Soviet prisoners of war and prepare an armed uprising. The Gestapo tries with all its might to expose the participants, captures underground members and tortures them, but the resistance of the Taganrog residents only grows.
title: Таганрог

overview: Konstantin Krestosotsev heads a group that solves mysterious crimes. Under his command are the charming psychologist Masha and the forensic expert Morozov, a firm believer in mysticism. Well versed in esotericism and occultism, Krusosotsev is confident that cases from his practice have a rational explanation - be it the living dead or the deadly curse of a famous psychic. However, soon the hero will have to face something truly incredible.
title: Крестоносцы

overview: In society, there are many products and ideas that we buy into. Some of these products, services or ideas are just plain bullshit. Well known magicians: Penn and Teller are here to knock some sense into people in a humorous and informal way and to explain why some things in life are just bullshit.
title: Penn & Teller: Bullshit!

overview: Delving into the current and acclaimed crime. Criminology Professor Leif GW Persson and TV host Camilla Kvartoft delves into unsolved cases, dives deep in the criminal histories and explores different techniques used to solve crimes.
title: Veckans brott

overview: Duck Dynasty: The Revival centers on Willie and Korie Robertson as they navigate life with their growing family of adult children and grandchildren, now part of the next generation carrying on the Robertson legacy at their Louisiana homestead. As the family business expands beyond ducks, Willie and Korie bring their signature wit and down-home charm while they explore the future of Duck Commander, support their children through marriage, parenthood, and entrepreneurship, and work to keep their legacy alive. However, Willie quickly realizes that this next generation isn't as Robertson as he originally thought.
title: Duck Dynasty: The Revival

overview: The Carters follows bona fide American teen heartthrobs, Nick and Aaron, who seemed to have it all, but behind their remarkable gifts was a family dealing with mental health struggles, drug addiction, and heartbreaking neglect. Their story is told by Aaron's twin sister, Angel, who unpacks the complicated family dynamics that led to the untimely deaths of three of the original five Carter kids as well as their father. The often enchanting but ultimately painful story of these engaging siblings begins in childhood as home movies reveal Nick and Aaron's undeniable and precocious talent. But fame and fortune were accompanied by rivalries, jealousies, and exploitation from those they relied on most, their parents. It is a sad and eye-opening tale shared by Angel and close family friends who also live in the spotlight including Melissa Joan Hart and Scout Willis. The film features exclusive interviews with those closest to the family, some who have never spoken out before.
title: The Carters: Hurts To Love You

overview: No Taste Like Home with Antoni Porowski invites viewers on a captivating culinary adventure. Antoni Porowski — joined by celebrity guests Awkwafina, Henry Golding, James Marsden, Florence Pugh, Issa Rae and Justin Theroux — curates bespoke journeys that uncover the rich stories behind treasured family recipes. From the mouthwatering origins of Theroux's family pasta in Italy to the vibrant flavors of Awkwafina's Korean heritage, each episode celebrates the deep connections between food, culture and identity. As they explore the world together, Antoni and his guests meet locals who share their own family traditions and culinary secrets. Each journey culminates in a heartfelt family meal featuring a regional classic, showcasing the beauty and diversity of their cultural heritage. From dining with royalty to off-road adventures, No Taste Like Home is filled with heartwarming moments, bold flavors, and surprising revelations that offer a delicious glimpse into the stories that shape us all.
title: No Taste Like Home with Antoni Porowski

overview: A muerte tells the story of the cautious Raúl, who reconnects with free-spirited and newly pregnant Marta, following his heart cancer diagnosis. They resume a friendship that began in childhood, and in a relationship brought together by fate, begin to test their beliefs about love. Can the commitment-phobic Marta fall in love? And can Raúl meet the love of his life?
title: A muerte

overview: The mini-series shows Suzane von Richthofen and Daniel Cravinhos' versions about their relationship, their motives and the shocking crime that took place on the night of October 31st 2002. Based on the proceedings of the trial, the story transits from narrative to the testimonies given at court, and further still, interviews with the cast, the Director and the criminologist and script writer.
title: A menina que matou os pais - A serie

overview: Swedish comedy series from 2015. Boy Machine was the largest boy band in the nineties but disbanded when frontman Mange wanted to pursue a solo career.Now, fifteen years after the split they reunite to take over the world. But it turns out to be more difficult than they ever expected.
title: Boy Machine

overview: London, 1851. The industrial revolution is changing the city. Bringing vivid colour in amongst the dirty red bricks and smoke stacks of the noisy bustling streets are four young, thrill-seeking, outspoken and audaciously creative mavericks John Millais, Dante Gabriel Rossetti, William Holman Hunt and Thomas Woolner otherwise known as the Brotherhood. Championed by the most famous art critic of the time, John Ruskin, the artists are also joined by sassy, sexy model Lizzie Siddal. Their quest for artistic immortality takes them into some of the most debauched, darkest and liveliest corners of the city.
title: The Love School

overview: CIA centers on two unlikely partners — a fast-talking, rule-breaking loose cannon CIA case officer, and a by-the-book, seasoned and smart FBI agent who believes in the rule of law. When this odd couple are assigned to work out of CIA's New York Station, they must learn to work together to investigate cases and criminals posing threats on U.S. soil, finding that their differences may actually be their strength.
title: CIA

overview: For the first time ever, top medal contenders in men's basketball granted behind-the-scenes access at the Olympic Games Paris 2024. Court of Gold gives an unfiltered, insider look at Team USA, France, Serbia and Canada as they gear up and battle for gold in Paris. International basketball has caught up to the U.S. and the competition and stakes are higher than ever.
title: Court of Gold

overview: Psychologist Li Mochou joins the Baizhou Public Security Bureau, giving Captain Ding Wei a powerful edge. With her criminal profiling skills, Ding Wei leads his team in solving a series of mysterious cases. As they dig deeper, the real mastermind behind a major unsolved case from years ago is finally exposed, bringing long-buried truths to light.
title: Lies Never Lie

overview: The most interesting people in the world join Tucker in his home.
title: The Tucker Carlson Show

overview: The news you need, first thing. Rahel Solomon has you covered with the latest headlines.
title: Early Start

overview: Kasie Hunt brings key players into the arena for sharp analysis and panel discussion on the latest news in politics and culture.
title: The Arena with Kasie Hunt

overview: Calleja en el Espacio, will follow renowned explorer and presenter Jesús Calleja in his most ambitious adventure to date: becoming the first Spanish civilian to travel to space.
title: Calleja en el Espacio

overview: Based on the hit podcast of the same name, Burden of Guilt follows Tracyraquel Berns' emotional journey to unravel the convoluted excuses that were given about her baby brother Matthew's sudden death when she was just two years old. Though initially ruled an accident, the mystery of how Matthew died haunts Tracyraquel throughout her childhood. After years of lies and unanswered questions, she obtains Matthew's medical records and uncovers a shocking detail; she learned she was blamed for his death. Tracyraquel embarks on a relentless search to expose the darkest and deepest secret of her troubled family. Her investigation leads the authorities in Dekalb County Georgia to an unprecedented decision to exhume Matthew's body 25 years after his death, which reveals that his death was a homicide.
title: Burden of Guilt

overview: Planet Weird is a quirky, light-hearted celebration of the planet's most bizarre creatures in the animal kingdom. Along with witty, tongue-in-cheek narration, by renowned UK comic Ross Noble, the series plays with pop culture, graphics, and human comparisons to make the absolute extremities of nature leap right off the screen and into the modern world. In short, digestible stories, viewers meet the critters who are faster than a speeding bullet, and more powerful than a locomotive. But inside every moment of ‘weird' is a revelation of cleverness, amazing adaptation and scientific surprise.
title: Planet Weird

overview: Ali Hassan will host a panel of celebrity advocates championing Canadian books that speak to this year's theme, "One Book to Change the Narrative." Each day of the competition, one book will be eliminated by the panellists until a winner is declared Canada's must-read book in 2025.
title: Canada Reads

overview: This 5-part documentary series reconstructs major events that shaped our world and shows how life evolved—despite apocalyptic catastrophes.
title: Fateful Planet

overview: Follow the busy daily lives of three Indigenous veterinarians at unique clinics across three provinces. Each vet serves a wide range of clients and pets with services ranging from animal acupuncture to behavioral expertise for pet anxiety. All three vets are fueled by their love for animals, putting their skills to the test every day by keeping the human/animal bond strong between owners and pets.
title: Incredible Northern Vets

overview: This documentary series explores Cape Cod's ghostly locations through interviews, historical narratives, photographs, videos, and brief reenactments.
title: Historically Haunted Cape Cod

overview: Pryce Cahill is an over-the-hill, ex-pro golfer whose career was derailed prematurely 20 years ago. After the collapse of his marriage and getting fired from his job at an Indiana sporting goods store, Pryce hedges his bets, and future, entirely on a troubled 17-year-old golf phenom named Santi. Stick is a heartfelt, feel-good comedy about a found family and their relationships set within the world of golf as it's never been shown before.
title: Stick

overview: "Samhällsjudo"(Societal Judo) Artist duo Frej Larsson and Simon Gärdenfors, better known as Father & Son, addressing both small and large social problem with a great sense of humor.
title: Samhällsjudo

overview: The FC Bayern of the 90s - characterized by guys like Matthäus, Klinsmann, Scholl and Basler - experienced probably the craziest years in the club's history. It was the birth of FC Hollywood.
title: FC Hollywood: Der FC Bayern und die verrückten 90er
